evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce PhyCoVE, a benchmark of 533 cases on 110 source videos that covers rigid, elastic, and fluid dynamics in five interaction patterns, with edits that remove an object, change a physical quantity, or insert a new object.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We also propose counterfactual fidelity, a metric that applies across materials and their interactions and measures how much of the physical change from the source video to the target video a generated video reproduces.
